SELECT
    p1.ProductName AS product_1,
    p2.ProductName AS product_2,
    count() AS orders_together
FROM
(
    SELECT
        SalesOrderNumber,
        arraySort(groupUniqArray(ProductKey)) AS products
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY SalesOrderNumber
    HAVING length(products) > 1
) AS o
ARRAY JOIN
    arrayEnumerate(o.products) AS i,
    arrayEnumerate(o.products) AS j
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p1
    ON p1.ProductKey = o.products[i]
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p2
    ON p2.ProductKey = o.products[j]
WHERE i < j
GROUP BY
    p1.ProductName,
    p2.ProductName
ORDER BY orders_together DESC, product_1, product_2
